body: SLICE-2 READ-ONLY DESIGN PRECHECK (no edits while P0-2 is live). The current defect is structural: RemotePolicy.evaluate accepts provider and model as loose caller claims, then copies request.space without resolving it. Minimal non-stringly repair: accept the target Embedder[F] instead of loose provider/model; derive provider = embedder.info.provider and model from the canonical EmbedderInfo field; resolve request.space through embedder.space; deny unknown space; and deny any advertised space whose EmbeddingSpace.provider != embedder.info.provider before allowlist checks. The capability then records only those derived identities. Adversarial laws: (1) allowed provider/model + foreign GeometryId denied, (2) an embedder advertising a space under a different provider denied, (3) unknown space denied, (4) no public API remains that lets a caller separately assert provider/model. This avoids new public vocabulary because Embedder already couples info + spaces. One chief choice is needed after P0-2: should policy model identity be info.name, or a version-qualified name derived from info.name + info.version? I favor version-qualified identity so policy and capability cannot silently survive an endpoint version change, while ProviderFingerprint remains the artifact-level proof.
